verdict.rationale: Letta has a documented programmatic surface: an Agent SDK for creating agents (`client.createAgent()`), resuming sessions and conversations, sending and streaming messages, setting memory, approving tool calls and choosing cloud or local backends. It also offers the App Server's OpenAI-compatible API, an ACP adapter and a headless CLI mode. However, many UI and interactive features are documented only through the web or desktop app, settings pages or slash commands, and nothing shows API equivalents for them: GitHub sync via the Integrations page, Slack, schedules, secrets, collaborators and permissions in org settings, pinning, and teleportation. The OpenAPI probe also found no published spec. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, API coverage of org, team, integration, schedule and secret management, a published OpenAPI/REST reference, and independent corroboration.
